purpose: Verify authorized Faculty, Dept_Admin, and HOD can create and publish announcements
preconditions: User has department.announcement.publish permission
action_or_input: Call publish with valid title, body, and audience targeting criteria
expected_result: Announcement is created and marked published with published_at timestamp set

purpose: Verify unauthorized user (e.g. Student without publish permission) cannot publish announcement
preconditions: User lacks department.announcement.publish permission
action_or_input: Attempt to create or publish announcement
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify system notifies relevant Students and Faculty when a new announcement is published
preconditions: Draft announcement exists with target scope
action_or_input: Publish announcement to target roles and programs
expected_result: Notification event is dispatched to matching audience

purpose: Verify announcement visibility is filtered by viewer role, program, and academic year
preconditions: Published announcements exist with different target audiences
action_or_input: Filter announcements for a viewer matching specific role, program, and year
expected_result: Only announcements matching viewer targeting criteria are returned

purpose: Verify announcements not matching viewer role, program, or academic year are hidden
preconditions: Published announcement targeted only to Faculty
action_or_input: Query announcements as a Student user
expected_result: The faculty-targeted announcement is excluded from results

purpose: Verify authenticated department users can view relevant announcements
preconditions: Authenticated department user and relevant active announcements exist
action_or_input: Retrieve active announcements for authenticated user
expected_result: Active relevant announcements are successfully returned

purpose: Verify HOD can edit any active department announcement
preconditions: Active announcement exists; actor is HOD with manage permission
action_or_input: HOD updates title and body of active announcement
expected_result: Announcement content is updated successfully

purpose: Verify non-HOD user cannot edit active department announcement
preconditions: Active announcement exists; actor is Dept_Admin or Faculty
action_or_input: Non-HOD attempts to edit active announcement
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify HOD can hide any active department announcement
preconditions: Active published announcement exists; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD calls hide on the announcement
expected_result: Announcement is_hidden becomes True and is_active becomes False

purpose: Verify non-HOD user cannot hide active department announcement
preconditions: Active published announcement exists; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Non-HOD actor calls hide on announcement
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify HOD can delete any active department announcement
preconditions: Active published announcement exists; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD calls soft_delete on the announcement
expected_result: Announcement deleted_at timestamp is set and is_active becomes False

purpose: Verify non-HOD user cannot delete active department announcement
preconditions: Active published announcement exists; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Non-HOD actor calls soft_delete on announcement
expected_result: PermissionDeniedError is raised

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can insert stock records into department inventory
preconditions: Actor has Dept_Admin permissions for inventory management
action_or_input: Create new InventoryItem with valid name, unit, and quantity
expected_result: InventoryItem is saved with specified stock quantity

purpose: Verify system maintains current inventory state and quantity for department stock items
preconditions: InventoryItem exists with quantity >= 0
action_or_input: Inspect InventoryItem quantity and non-negative check constraint
expected_result: Current quantity is preserved and negative quantities are rejected

purpose: Verify system records every stock insertion in an immutable stock-movement log
preconditions: InventoryItem exists; stock insertion performed
action_or_input: Create StockMovement record for insertion
expected_result: StockMovement created with type insertion, quantity_before and quantity_after matching insertion

purpose: Verify stock movement log is immutable against modification or deletion
preconditions: StockMovement record exists in database
action_or_input: Attempt to call save() with modified values or delete() on StockMovement
expected_result: ValidationError is raised and operation is blocked

purpose: Verify Faculty members can submit requests for department inventory items
preconditions: InventoryItem exists with positive stock; requester is Faculty
action_or_input: Submit StockRequest for item with requested_quantity and purpose
expected_result: StockRequest is created with status PENDING

purpose: Verify requested stock quantity is validated against current inventory level before accepting request
preconditions: InventoryItem exists with current quantity = 5
action_or_input: Faculty submits StockRequest with requested_quantity = 3 (<= 5)
expected_result: Validation succeeds and request enters PENDING status

purpose: Verify requested stock quantity exceeding current inventory is rejected before acceptance
preconditions: InventoryItem exists with current quantity = 5
action_or_input: Faculty submits StockRequest with requested_quantity = 10 (> 5)
expected_result: ValidationError is raised and request is not accepted

purpose: Verify HOD can approve or reject a pending Faculty stock request
preconditions: Pending StockRequest exists; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD records approval decision
expected_result: StockRequest status changes to APPROVED with decided_at and decided_by set

purpose: Verify HOD can reject a pending Faculty stock request
preconditions: Pending StockRequest exists; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD records rejection decision
expected_result: StockRequest status changes to REJECTED with decided_at and decision_note

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can issue stock only for a request approved by HOD
preconditions: StockRequest with status APPROVED exists; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin issues the approved stock request
expected_result: StockRequest status changes to ISSUED with issued_at and issued_by set

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin cannot issue stock for a request that has not been approved by HOD
preconditions: StockRequest with status PENDING exists; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to issue the pending stock request
expected_result: Operation is rejected with ValidationError or ConflictError

purpose: Verify system automatically decrements relevant inventory quantity when approved stock is issued
preconditions: InventoryItem quantity = 10; approved StockRequest for quantity = 3
action_or_input: Stock issuance is completed
expected_result: InventoryItem quantity decrements to 7 (10 - 3)

purpose: Verify system records every stock issuance in an immutable stock-movement log
preconditions: Approved StockRequest is issued
action_or_input: Inspect StockMovement audit trail for the issuance event
expected_result: StockMovement created with movement_type issuance, linking stock_request and verified quantity decrease

purpose: Verify real-time notification/email sent to Dept_Admin when new stock request is submitted
preconditions: Faculty submits valid stock request
action_or_input: Trigger stock request submission
expected_result: Notification event dispatched to Dept_Admin

purpose: Verify notification sent to HOD when stock request requires HOD authorization
preconditions: Stock request validated and requires HOD approval
action_or_input: Stock request enters Pending HOD Approval stage
expected_result: Notification event dispatched to HOD

purpose: Verify requesting Faculty member notified when stock request reaches Issued or Rejected outcome
preconditions: Stock request reaches terminal state Issued or Rejected
action_or_input: Final outcome transition occurs
expected_result: Notification event dispatched to requesting Faculty

purpose: Verify Faculty members can view their relevant issued-stock history
preconditions: Issued stock requests exist for Faculty member
action_or_input: Query stock history as requesting Faculty member
expected_result: Faculty member receives list of issued stock requests requested by them

purpose: Verify authenticated Students and Faculty can submit department feedback
preconditions: Authenticated Student or Faculty user
action_or_input: Submit feedback item with content and category
expected_result: Feedback record created with status New

purpose: Verify submitted feedback is protected as confidential information accessible only within authorized scope
preconditions: Confidential feedback submitted by user
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to access feedback details
expected_result: Access is denied or unauthorized user cannot view feedback

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin is notified when new feedback is submitted
preconditions: Feedback submitted
action_or_input: Feedback submission event triggers
expected_result: Notification dispatched to Dept_Admin

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can perform initial review of newly submitted feedback
preconditions: Feedback in status New; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin reviews feedback
expected_result: Feedback transitions to Under Review status

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can categorize feedback during initial review
preconditions: Feedback under initial review; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin assigns category to feedback
expected_result: Feedback category is updated and recorded

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can close a feedback item considered a simple issue during initial review
preconditions: Simple feedback issue under initial review; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin closes feedback with resolution note
expected_result: Feedback transitions to Closed status

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin or HOD can mark feedback as Resolved or Closed
preconditions: Feedback has undergone initial review
action_or_input: Authorized Dept_Admin or HOD marks feedback Resolved
expected_result: Feedback reaches terminal Resolved or Closed status

purpose: Verify HOD can access feedback after initial review for oversight and resolution
preconditions: Feedback in Under Review status (post initial review); actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD accesses feedback item
expected_result: HOD is granted access to review and resolve feedback

purpose: Verify feedback submitter is notified when feedback is marked Resolved or Closed
preconditions: Feedback reaches terminal state Resolved or Closed
action_or_input: Feedback resolution occurs
expected_result: Notification dispatched to original feedback submitter

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can manage Faculty, Student, and Alumni profile records within department
preconditions: Actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin creates or updates department user profile record
expected_result: Profile record is updated successfully

purpose: Verify Students can view only basic, permitted profile information for peer Students and Faculty
preconditions: Viewer is Student
action_or_input: Student retrieves peer Student or Faculty profile
expected_result: Basic permitted profile information is returned; private details withheld

purpose: Verify Faculty can view detailed profile information for Students in their courses
preconditions: Viewer is Faculty; student is enrolled in faculty course
action_or_input: Faculty retrieves student profile
expected_result: Detailed course-related profile information is accessible

purpose: Verify Faculty can view permitted limited-scope profile information for Faculty and Alumni
preconditions: Viewer is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty retrieves other Faculty or Alumni profile
expected_result: Limited-scope professional profile data returned

purpose: Verify HOD and Dept_Admin can view full department user profiles except sensitive privacy-protected data
preconditions: Viewer is HOD or Dept_Admin
action_or_input: HOD/Dept_Admin retrieves full department profile
expected_result: Full profile returned while sensitive personal data is excluded

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can upload class and lab timetables
preconditions: Actor is Dept_Admin; timetable data is non-conflicting
action_or_input: Upload new timetable schedule
expected_result: Timetable schedule saved successfully

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can modify existing class and lab timetables
preconditions: Existing timetable; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Modify timetable slot with valid parameters
expected_result: Timetable modification saved successfully

purpose: Verify system detects overlapping timetable slots and blocks saving when conflict exists
preconditions: Timetable slot exists at specific day/time/room
action_or_input: Dept_Admin attempts to save second slot overlapping same day/time/room
expected_result: Conflict detected and save is blocked with validation error

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can update department lab equipment and resource profile details
preconditions: Lab resource profile exists; actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Dept_Admin updates equipment specifications and availability
expected_result: Resource profile details updated successfully

purpose: Verify Faculty can view department lab resource profiles for planning
preconditions: Lab resource profile exists; viewer is Faculty
action_or_input: Faculty retrieves lab resource profiles
expected_result: Resource profile information is displayed to Faculty

purpose: Verify Students can view department academic program information
preconditions: Academic program details exist; viewer is Student
action_or_input: Student queries academic program information
expected_result: Program information returned successfully

purpose: Verify Students can view applicable class/lab timetable information
preconditions: Timetable exists for student program/year; viewer is Student
action_or_input: Student retrieves applicable timetable
expected_result: Applicable timetable schedule returned

purpose: Verify Dept_Admin can update general non-official department information
preconditions: Actor is Dept_Admin
action_or_input: Update general contact/about information
expected_result: General information updated immediately without approval

purpose: Verify proposed official department-detail changes are kept pending until HOD approval
preconditions: Actor is Dept_Admin proposing official change
action_or_input: Submit official change (e.g. Department Name or Core Policy)
expected_result: Change is held in pending status and not published/effective

purpose: Verify HOD can approve a pending official department-detail change
preconditions: Pending official change exists; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD approves the official change
expected_result: Approved change becomes effective in official department record

purpose: Verify HOD rejection of official change retains current department data
preconditions: Pending official change exists; actor is HOD
action_or_input: HOD rejects the official change
expected_result: Change rejected; current department details remain unchanged

purpose: Verify central Institute Admin can assign Dept_Admin and HOD roles to institute employees
preconditions: Actor is central Institute Admin / authorized authority
action_or_input: Assign HOD or Dept_Admin role to employee for department
expected_result: Role assignment record created

purpose: Verify time-bounded validity period is maintained for active role assignments
preconditions: Role assignment being configured
action_or_input: Specify start_date and end_date for role tenure
expected_result: Tenure dates recorded and validated

purpose: Verify immediate revocation of Department-role access from outgoing HOD or Dept_Admin upon effective transition
preconditions: Reassignment becomes effective
action_or_input: Trigger effective transition
expected_result: Outgoing user permissions/access revoked immediately

purpose: Verify immediate grant of Department-role access to incoming HOD or Dept_Admin upon effective transition
preconditions: Reassignment becomes effective
action_or_input: Trigger effective transition
expected_result: Incoming user granted role permissions immediately

purpose: Verify system enforces exactly one active HOD role assignment per department at any given time
preconditions: Active HOD assignment already exists for department
action_or_input: Attempt concurrent active HOD assignment without transition
expected_result: System blocks duplicate active HOD assignment with uniqueness violation

purpose: Verify system enforces exactly one active Dept_Admin role assignment per department at any given time
preconditions: Active Dept_Admin assignment already exists for department
action_or_input: Attempt concurrent active Dept_Admin assignment without transition
expected_result: System blocks duplicate active Dept_Admin assignment with uniqueness violation

purpose: Verify system derives department displayed Headship from current active HOD role assignment
preconditions: Active HOD role assignment exists maintained by Institute Admin
action_or_input: Query displayed department Headship identity
expected_result: Displayed Headship matches employee assigned active HOD role
